#
# Fluentd
#
#    Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");

#    See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
#    limitations under the License.
#

module Fluent
  module PluginHelper
    module RetryState
      def retry_state_create(
          title, retry_type, wait, timeout,
          forever: false, max_steps: nil, backoff_base: 2, max_interval: nil, randomize: true, randomize_width: 0.125,
          secondary: false, secondary_threshold: 0.8
      )
        case retry_type
        when :exponential_backoff
          ExponentialBackOffRetry.new(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, backoff_base, max_interval, secondary, secondary_threshold)
        when :periodic
          PeriodicRetry.new(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)
        else
          raise "BUG: unknown retry_type specified: '#{retry_type}'"
        end
      end

      class RetryStateMachine
        attr_reader :title, :start, :steps, :next_time, :timeout_at, :current, :secondary_transition_at, :secondary_transition_steps

        def initialize(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)
          @title = title

          @start = current_time
          @steps = 0
          @next_time = nil # should be initialized for first retry by child class

          @timeout = timeout
          @timeout_at = @start + timeout
          @current = :primary

          if randomize_width < 0 || randomize_width > 0.5
            raise "BUG: randomize_width MUST be between 0 and 0.5"
          end

          @randomize = randomize
          @randomize_width = randomize_width

          @forever = forever
          @max_steps = max_steps

          @secondary = secondary
          @secondary_threshold = secondary_threshold
          if @secondary
            raise "BUG: secondary_transition_threshold MUST be between 0 and 1" if @secondary_threshold <= 0 || @secondary_threshold >= 1
            max_retry_timeout = timeout
            if max_steps
              timeout_by_max_steps = calc_max_retry_timeout(max_steps)
              max_retry_timeout = timeout_by_max_steps if timeout_by_max_steps < max_retry_timeout
            end
            @secondary_transition_at = @start + max_retry_timeout * @secondary_threshold
            @secondary_transition_steps = nil
          end
        end

        def current_time
          Time.now
        end

        def randomize(interval)
          return interval unless @randomize

          interval + (interval * @randomize_width * (2 * rand - 1.0))
        end

        def calc_next_time
          if @forever || !@secondary # primary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps)
            if @forever
              naive
            elsif naive >= @timeout_at
              @timeout_at
            else
              naive
            end
          elsif @current == :primary && @secondary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps)
            if naive >= @secondary_transition_at
              @secondary_transition_at
            else
              naive
            end
          elsif @current == :secondary
            naive = naive_next_time(@steps - @secondary_transition_steps + 1)
            if naive >= @timeout_at
              @timeout_at
            else
              naive
            end
          else
            raise "BUG: it's out of design"
          end
        end

        def naive_next_time(retry_times)
          raise NotImplementedError
        end

        def secondary?
          !@forever && @secondary && (@current == :secondary || current_time >= @secondary_transition_at)
        end

        def step
          @steps += 1
          if !@forever && @secondary && @current != :secondary && current_time >= @secondary_transition_at
            @current = :secondary
            @secondary_transition_steps = @steps
          end
          @next_time = calc_next_time
          nil
        end

        def recalc_next_time
          @next_time = calc_next_time
        end

        def limit?
          if @forever
            false
          else
            @next_time >= @timeout_at || !!(@max_steps && @steps >= @max_steps)
          end
        end
      end

      class ExponentialBackOffRetry < RetryStateMachine
        def initialize(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, backoff_base, max_interval, secondary, secondary_threshold)
          @constant_factor = wait
          @backoff_base = backoff_base
          @max_interval = max_interval

          super(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)

          @next_time = @start + @constant_factor
        end

        def naive_next_time(retry_next_times)
          intr = calc_interval(retry_next_times)
          current_time + randomize(intr)
        end

        def calc_max_retry_timeout(max_steps)
          result = 0
          max_steps.times { |i|
            result += calc_interval(i)
          }
          result
        end

        def calc_interval(num)
          interval = raw_interval(num - 1)
          if @max_interval && interval > @max_interval
            @max_interval
          else
            if interval.finite?
              interval
            else
              # Calculate previous finite value to avoid inf related errors. If this re-computing is heavy, use cache.
              until interval.finite?
                num -= 1
                interval = raw_interval(num - 1)
              end
              interval
            end
          end
        end

        def raw_interval(num)
          @constant_factor.to_f * (@backoff_base ** (num))
        end
      end

      class PeriodicRetry < RetryStateMachine
        def initialize(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)
          @retry_wait = wait

          super(title, wait, timeout, forever, max_steps, randomize, randomize_width, secondary, secondary_threshold)

          @next_time = @start + @retry_wait
        end

        def naive_next_time(retry_next_times)
          current_time + randomize(@retry_wait)
        end

        def calc_max_retry_timeout(max_steps)
          @retry_wait * max_steps
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

def check_slow_flush(start)
        elapsed_time = Fluent::Clock.now - start
        elapsed_millsec = (elapsed_time * 1000).to_i
        @flush_time_count_metrics.add(elapsed_millsec)
        if elapsed_time > @slow_flush_log_threshold
          @slow_flush_count_metrics.inc
          log.warn "buffer flush took longer time than slow_flush_log_threshold:",
                   elapsed_time: elapsed_time, slow_flush_log_threshold: @slow_flush_log_threshold, plugin_id: self.plugin_id
        end
      end

      def update_retry_state(chunk_id, using_secondary, error = nil)
        @retry_mutex.synchronize do
          @num_errors_metrics.inc
          chunk_id_hex = Fluent::UniqueId.hex(chunk_id)

          unless @retry
            @retry = retry_state(@buffer_config.retry_randomize)
            if error
              log.warn "failed to flush the buffer.", retry_times: @retry.steps, next_retry_time: @retry.next_time.round, chunk: chunk_id_hex, error: error
              log.warn_backtrace error.backtrace
            end
            return
          end

          # @retry exists

          retry_forever = @retry.instance_variable_get(:@forever)
          retry_max_steps = @retry.instance_variable_get(:@max_steps)
          retry_timeout_at = @retry.timeout_at
          retry_next_time = @retry.next_time
          retry_steps = @retry.steps
          retry_secondary = @retry.instance_variable_get(:@secondary)
          retry_current = @retry.current
          retry_randomize = @retry.instance_variable_get(:@randomize)
          retry_randomize_width = @retry.instance_variable_get(:@randomize_width)
          retry_secondary_transition_at = @retry.instance_variable_get(:@secondary_transition_at)
          retry_secondary_transition_steps = @retry.instance_variable_get(:@secondary_transition_steps)

          hit_retry_limit = false
          if retry_forever
            hit_retry_limit = false
          else
            if retry_next_time >= retry_timeout_at
              hit_retry_limit = true
            else
              if retry_max_steps
                if retry_steps >= retry_max_steps
                  hit_retry_limit = true
                else
                  hit_retry_limit = false
                end
              else
                hit_retry_limit = false
              end
            end
          end

          if hit_retry_limit
            if error
              records = 0
              @buffer.synchronize do
                queued_chunks = @buffer.instance_variable_get(:@queue)
                queued_chunks.each do |queued_chunk|
                  if queued_chunk.instance_variable_defined?(:@chunk_bytes)
                    committed_records = queued_chunk.instance_variable_get(:@size)
                    pending_records = queued_chunk.instance_variable_get(:@adding_size)
                    records += committed_records.to_i + pending_records.to_i
                  else
                    records += queued_chunk.size
                  end
                end
              end
              msg = "failed to flush the buffer, and hit limit for retries. dropping all chunks in the buffer queue."
              log.error msg, retry_times: @retry.steps, records: records, error: error
              log.error_backtrace error.backtrace
            end
            @buffer.clear_queue!
            log.debug "buffer queue cleared"
            @retry = nil
          else
            now_time = Time.now
            if now_time >= retry_next_time
              retry_steps = retry_steps + 1
              @retry.instance_variable_set(:@steps, retry_steps)
              unless retry_forever
                if retry_secondary
                  if retry_current != :secondary
                    transition_now = Time.now
                    if transition_now >= retry_secondary_transition_at
                      @retry.instance_variable_set(:@current, :secondary)
                      @retry.instance_variable_set(:@secondary_transition_steps, retry_steps)
                      retry_current = :secondary
                      retry_secondary_transition_steps = retry_steps
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end

            naive_steps = retry_steps
            if retry_current == :secondary
              naive_steps = retry_steps - retry_secondary_transition_steps + 1
            end

            base_interval = nil
            if @retry.is_a?(Fluent::PluginHelper::RetryState::ExponentialBackOffRetry)
              constant_factor = @retry.instance_variable_get(:@constant_factor)
              backoff_base = @retry.instance_variable_get(:@backoff_base)
              max_interval = @retry.instance_variable_get(:@max_interval)
              interval_num = naive_steps - 1
              factor_value = constant_factor.to_f
              power_base = backoff_base
              power_exponent = interval_num
              if power_exponent == 0
                grown_interval = factor_value
              else
                grown_interval = factor_value * (power_base ** power_exponent)
              end
              capped_by_max = false
              if max_interval
                if grown_interval > max_interval
                  grown_interval = max_interval
                  capped_by_max = true
                end
              end
              unless capped_by_max
                unless grown_interval.finite?
                  until grown_interval.finite?
                    interval_num = interval_num - 1
                    grown_interval = factor_value * (power_base ** interval_num)
                  end
                end
              end
              base_interval = grown_interval
            else
              base_interval = @retry.instance_variable_get(:@retry_wait)
            end

            if retry_randomize
              jitter_span = base_interval * retry_randomize_width
              jitter_unit = 2 * rand - 1.0
              base_interval = base_interval + (jitter_span * jitter_unit)
            end

            naive_next = Time.now + base_interval
            computed_next_time = naive_next
            if retry_forever
              computed_next_time = naive_next
            else
              if retry_secondary
                if retry_current == :secondary
                  if naive_next >= retry_timeout_at
                    computed_next_time = retry_timeout_at
                  else
                    computed_next_time = naive_next
                  end
                else
                  if naive_next >= retry_secondary_transition_at
                    computed_next_time = retry_secondary_transition_at
                  else
                    computed_next_time = naive_next
                  end
                end
              else
                if naive_next >= retry_timeout_at
                  computed_next_time = retry_timeout_at
                else
                  computed_next_time = naive_next
                end
              end
            end
            @retry.instance_variable_set(:@next_time, computed_next_time)

            if error
              if using_secondary
                msg = "failed to flush the buffer with secondary output."
                log.warn msg, retry_times: @retry.steps, next_retry_time: @retry.next_time.round, chunk: chunk_id_hex, error: error
                log.warn_backtrace error.backtrace
              else
                msg = "failed to flush the buffer."
                log.warn msg, retry_times: @retry.steps, next_retry_time: @retry.next_time.round, chunk: chunk_id_hex, error: error
                log.warn_backtrace error.backtrace
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end

      def retry_state(randomize)

part.text:
Fixed. In `update_retry_state` (lib/fluent/plugin/output.rb:1276), when `@retry` is first created it now checks `@retry.limit?` — with `retry_max_times 0` (`steps >= max_steps` → `0 >= 0`), the state machine immediately falls through to the "hit limit for retries" block, so chunks are dropped without any retry instead of being scheduled for a retry.

Verified: `test_output_as_buffered_retries.rb`, `test_output.rb`, `test_output_as_buffered.rb`, `test_output_as_buffered_secondary.rb`, and `test_output_as_buffered_overflow.rb` all pass.
